endpoint: Continue the E302 generic-only principal-square constructor on a disjoint deterministic family of half ideals.
inputs: The frozen E302 cubic/S/generic-M17 constructor arithmetic and the reusable exact local/character routines. M24, all public exceptional words and rational cover witnesses are forbidden.
method: At each fully split good rational prime choose the second, rather than first, degree-one prime ideal in PARI decomposition order. Use the first twenty such distinct rational primes. Enumerate all nonempty subset half ideals J, verify J^2=(alpha) exactly through idealred, then retain only strict generic-corrected classes with a good-prime character outside generic M17.
failure_semantics: A completed negative result closes only this second-factor finite family. It supplies no class-group, Selmer, Sha or rank bound. Any positive strict class still requires post-hoc M24 independence, an independently solved cover and a point-rank certificate.
